items.name: Founder's Mystery Fashion Crate
details: Contains one random decorative equip. The 7-day duration belongs to the unopened crate.
Reward item lifetimes are not stated in the announcement or rate table.
Unwanted unequipped rewards can be exchanged for Aurora Stamps.
Mystery purchases are unavailable in Belgium, Slovakia and Brazil.
Rewards obtained in the Netherlands can only be traded within the account.
Angel Wand, Orange Toy Hammer and Yellow Spatula cover any weapon. Cherub’s Bow covers Bow-type weapons only.

items.name: Aurora Mystery Fashion Crate
details: Contains one random decorative equip. The 7-day duration belongs to the unopened crate.
Reward item lifetimes are not stated in the announcement or rate table.
Unwanted unequipped rewards can be exchanged for Aurora Stamps.
Mystery purchases are unavailable in Belgium, Slovakia and Brazil.
Rewards obtained in the Netherlands can only be traded within the account.
Soft Chocolate Fondue Scepter, Detective Glass and Starlight Heart Scepter cover any weapon.

items.name: Mystery Palette Exchange Coupon
details: Randomly changes the color of a Dyeable decoration item once.
Coupon is tradable, however the resulting item cannot be traded.
Even if used multiple times, the colors will be changed based on the item's original appearance.
Special effects and certain weapons will retain their original color even if a Palette is used.
An item must have been equipped or been otherwise made untradable for a Palette to be used on it.
Outfit items that can be recolored with Palettes are marked with the Aurora Badge in the item icon, indicating that it has absorbed the power of Aurora and can be dyed.
The list of items that can be dyed with Palettes can be found here.
Coupon expires in 14 days; the resulting utility item expires in 30 days.

items.name: Palette Cleanser Exchange Coupon
details: Reverts the color of an item dyed with a Palette (such as the Mystery Palette) once.
Coupon is tradable, however the resulting item cannot be traded.
The list of items that can be dyed with Palettes can be found here.
Coupon expires in 14 days; the resulting utility item expires in 30 days.

items.name: Mystery Hair Coupon
details: Mystery purchases are unavailable in Belgium, Slovakia and Brazil.
Take the coupon to Hair Salon in town. A style is chosen randomly.
Male styles: Bed Head Hair, Prince Cut Hair, Short Regent Cut, Dreamcatcher, Metrosexual Hair, Antagonist.
Female styles: Lovely Ladyhawk, Ponytail-to-the-Side, Vivacious Wavy Hair, Angelica Hair, Caspia Hair, Rose.

items.name: Mystery Face Coupon
details: Mystery purchases are unavailable in Belgium, Slovakia and Brazil.
Take the coupon to Plastic Surgery in town. A style is chosen randomly.
Male styles: Innocent Gaze, Distant Gaze, Rebel's Fire, Worrisome Glare, Alert Face, Overjoyed Smile.
Female styles: Prim Face, Posh Look, Bulbous-Eyed Face, Round Eyed Face, Beauty Stare, Strong Stare.

items.name: Signature Hair Coupon
details: Take the coupon to Hair Salon in town. Choose the style you want.
Male styles: Bowl Cut, Line Scratch Hair, Chestnut, Mohecan Shaggy 'Do, Medium Cornrows, Mane.
Female styles: Bridget, Jolie, Holla' Back 'Do, Veronica, Rastafari Hair, Penelope Hair.

items.name: Signature Face Coupon
details: Take the coupon to Plastic Surgery in town. Choose the style you want.
Male styles: Smart Aleck, Cool Guy Gaze, Insomniac Daze, Look of Wonder, Wisdom Glance, Babyface Pout.
Female styles: Curious Look, Hera's Radiance, Gentle Glow, Hopeless Gaze, Wide-eyed Girl, Babyface Pout.

items.name: Fall Store Permit
details: This special-edition coupon allows you to open an orange tree store in which you can list up to 18 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

items.name: Monthly Essentials
details: 20 Megaphone Exchange Coupon (30-day duration)
Transparent Hat (30-day duration)
Transparent Cape (30-day duration)
Transparent Shoes (30-day duration)
5 Double Item Megaphone Exchange Coupon (30-day duration)
Special Store Permit (30-day duration)
Portable Storage (30-day duration)
Purchasable once per world, with an additional purchase being made available after 30 days.
Can only be purchased with NX.
Both the package and its contents are untradable.

items.name: Convenience Essentials Pack
details: SP Reset Scroll
AP Reset Scroll
Selective 5-slot Coupon
Safety Charm (10) (90-day duration)
Super Megaphone (10) (90-day duration)
Can be purchased once per account.
Can only be purchased with NX.
Both the package and its contents are untradable.

items.name: Pet Booster Essentials Pack
details: Auto HP Potion Skill
Auto MP Potion Skill
Auto Move Skill
Expanded Auto Move Skill
30 Premium Pet Food Exchange Coupon (90-day duration)
Can be purchased once per account.
Can only be purchased with NX.
Both the package and its contents are untradable.

items.name: Mystery Hair Color Coupon
details: Can be used at the Hair Salon in town to randomly change your hair color.
Players in Belgium, Slovakia, and Brazil are unable to purchase Mystery items.
Mystery purchases are unavailable in Belgium, Slovakia and Brazil.

items.name: Signature Hair Color Coupon
details: Can be used at the Hair Salon in town to change your hair color to a color of your choice.

items.name: Signature Eye Color Coupon
details: Can be used at the Plastic Surgery shop in town to change your eye color to a color of your choice.

items.name: Signature Skin Color Coupon
details: Can be used at Henesys Skin-Care to change your skin color to a color of your choice.

items.name: Water of Life
details: Can be used to extend the duration of a pet by 30 days, or brought to Mar the Fairy in Ellinia to restore a pet that has been turned into a doll, giving it a 30-day duration.

items.name: Pet Name Tag
details: Used to name your pet.
Pets will respond much better if their name is called prior to making a command (ie: "Lucky, sit!").

items.name: Auto HP Potion Skill
details: Allows your pet to use HP potions on you when your HP falls below the threshold that you set.

items.name: Auto MP Potion Skill
details: Allows your pet to use MP potions on you when your MP falls below the threshold that you set.

items.name: Auto Move Skill
details: Adds a skill that allows your pet to automatically pick up nearby items and mesos without having to move. Can be used on pets with Meso Magnet or Item Pouch.

items.name: Expanded Auto Move Skill
details: Triples your pet's auto move distance. Can only be used on pets with the Auto Move Skill.

items.name: AP Reset Scroll
details: Resets all stats, including AP invested in HP/MP.
Must be at least Lv. 10 to use.
items.imageAlt: AP and SP Reset Scrolls illustration

items.name: SP Reset Scroll
details: Resets all skills, excluding Beginner skills.
items.imageAlt: AP and SP Reset Scrolls illustration

items.name: Megaphone
details: Shout to everyone in the channel your character is on with this megaphone. Only available for characters that are at least Level 10.

items.name: Super Megaphone
details: Shout to everyone in the world your character is on with this megaphone. Only available for characters that are at least Level 10.

items.name: Item Megaphone
details: Use this megaphone to broadcast to everyone in your world about an item that may be for sale. Only available for characters that are at least Level 10.

items.name: Storage Room 5-slot Coupon
details: Double-click to expand your Storage Room by 5 slots. You may have up to 150 slots.

items.name: Selective 5-slot Coupon
details: Double-click to expand one of your tabs (Equip, Use, Set-up, Etc) by 5 slots. Each tab can be expanded up to a total of 150 slots.

items.name: Safety Charm
details: It does not let the user lose EXP points after death, as long as it's in possession. 100% of your HP and MP will be recovered when you are revived. This item is consumed upon use.

items.name: Regular Store Permit
details: Allows you to open a regular store in which you can list up to 12 items at once. Can be used in fields or the Free Market.
If you are attacked or killed by a monster, the store will close.

items.name: Pink Store Permit
